title: Bridging Skill Gaps for the Future: New Jobs Creation in the AI Age
Shaping Innovation: Can Industrial Policies Boost Patent Applications?
Energy security and the green transition
abstract: The current energy crisis has raised important policy questions on how to strengthen short-term energy security while remaining firmly committed to the green transition, a challenge amplified by the recent consensus at COP28 to transition away from fossil fuels. This paper examines the historical determinants of the security of energy supply and analyzes the green transition implications for energy security. Looking back, we find that the diversification of energy trade partners, or the lack thereof, was the main factor that underpinned energy security dynamics within and across countries over the last two decades. Looking ahead, the green transition is expected to have a net positive effect on energy security provided investments are aligned to address new challenges posed by the increased reliance on renewables.
abstract_zh: 当前的能源危机提出了重要的政策问题：如何在坚定致力于绿色转型的同时，加强短期能源安全；而在COP28上达成的逐步摆脱化石燃料的共识，又使这一挑战更加突出。本文考察了能源供应安全的历史决定因素，并分析了绿色转型对能源安全的影响。回顾过去，我们发现，能源贸易伙伴的多元化（或缺乏多元化）是过去二十年间各国内部及各国之间能源安全动态的主要决定因素。展望未来，只要投资能够针对可再生能源依赖度上升所带来的新挑战进行调整，绿色转型预计将对能源安全产生净正面效应。

title: Do Industrial Policies Increase Trade Competitiveness?

The Drivers and Macroeconomic Impacts of Low-Carbon Innovation: A Cross-Country Exploration
abstract: This paper investigates how climate policies affect low-carbon innovation (as measured by patents) and assesses the link between such innovation and economic activity. Climate policies, including international cooperation, spur both specific and overall innovation, with regulations, emissions-trading systems, and expenditure measures such as R&D subsidies and feed-in tariffs being particularly impactful. In turn, low-carbon innovation raises economic activity as much as other types of innovation and past technological revolutions. However, the mechanisms are different: low-carbon innovation increases capital accumulation, while other types of innovation increase total factor productivity (TFP).
abstract_zh: 本文研究气候政策如何影响低碳创新（以专利衡量），并评估此类创新与经济活动之间的联系。气候政策，包括国际合作，既能促进特定创新，也能推动整体创新，其中规制、排放交易体系以及研发补贴和上网电价等支出措施的影响尤为显著。反过来，低碳创新对经济活动的提升作用与其他类型的创新以及过去的技术革命相当。然而，其作用机制有所不同：低碳创新增加资本积累，而其他类型的创新则提高全要素生产率（TFP）。

title: Climate policy options: A comparison of economic performance
abstract: We use a global computable general equilibrium model to compare the economic performance of alternative climate policies along multiple dimensions, including macroeconomic outcomes, energy prices, and trade competitiveness. Carbon pricing which keeps the aggregate cost lower and preserves better the overall competitiveness than across-the-board regulation is the first-best policy, especially in energy intensive and trade exposed industries. Regulations and feebates are good alternatives in the power sector, where technological substitution is possible. Feed-in subsidies, if used alone, are not cost effective.
abstract_zh: 我们利用全球可计算一般均衡模型，从宏观经济结果、能源价格和贸易竞争力等多个维度，比较各种替代气候政策的经济表现。碳定价是最优政策，与全面的监管相比，它能使总成本更低，并更好地保持整体竞争力，在能源密集型和贸易暴露型行业中尤为如此。在技术替代可能实现的电力部门，监管和费率调整是较好的替代选择。若单独使用，上网补贴的成本效益不高。

title: Global climate policy with differentiated carbon price floors
abstract: We use a state-of-the-art global general equilibrium model to quantify the effects of an International Carbon Price Floor (ICPF) proposal for the coordination of global climate policy. With the ICPF proposal, countries would implement a carbon price floor that is differentiated according to their level of development. The price floor could be implemented by an actual carbon price or other policies with equivalent stringency. Implementing such a joint effort would be a big step towards aligning global emissions with the Paris Agreement. The study highlights three main findings. First, the ICPF is progressive in terms of emission reductions and demands considerably more effort from high-income countries (HICs). Unlike proposals based on equity principles, however, it requires neither extremely high emission reductions from HICs nor massive financial transfers. Second, the differentiated carbon prices cost only an additional 0.3 percent of global GDP compared to a global uniform carbon price. Third, the ICPF can be as effective as border carbon adjustment (BCA) mechanisms at preserving competitiveness of HICs despite the differentiation in carbon price floors. This means, there would be no need for BCA with an ICPF. Compared to a BCA, HICs can avoid the administrative burden and low-income countries (LICs) will not face the cost of BCA. As a first step to global climate policy, a sectoral ICPF for the EITE sector could be introduced. It would address competitiveness concerns almost as well as the full ICPF.
abstract_zh: 我们利用最先进的全球一般均衡模型，量化国际碳价格下限（ICPF）提案对全球气候政策协调的影响。在国际碳价格下限提案下，各国将根据其发展水平实施差异化的碳价格下限。该价格下限可以通过实际碳价格或其他具有同等严格程度的政策来实现。实施这一联合行动将是使全球排放与《巴黎协定》保持一致的重大一步。研究突出了三项主要发现。第一，国际碳价格下限在减排方面具有累进性，对高收入国家（HICs）的努力要求明显更高。然而，与基于公平原则的提案不同，它既不要求高收入国家进行极高的减排，也不需要大规模的财政转移。第二，与全球统一碳价格相比，差异化的碳价格仅使全球GDP额外减少0.3%。第三，在维持高收入国家竞争力方面，国际碳价格下限与边境碳调整（BCA）机制一样有效，尽管碳价格下限存在差异。这意味着，在实施国际碳价格下限的情况下无需边境碳调整。与边境碳调整相比，高收入国家可以避免行政负担，而低收入国家（LICs）也不必承担边境碳调整的成本。作为迈向全球气候政策的第一步，可以对能源密集型和贸易暴露型（EITE）部门引入部门性的国际碳价格下限。它在解决竞争力问题方面的效果几乎与完整的国际碳价格下限相当。

Structural Reforms to Accelerate Growth, Ease Policy Trade-offs, and Support the Green Transition in Emerging Market and Developing Economies
abstract: In the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic, emerging market and developing economies are grappling with economic scarring, social tension, and reduced policy space. Policy actions are already urgently needed to boost growth in the near term and support the ongoing green transition. At the same time, high public debt and persistently high inflation have constrained policy space, posing difficult policy trade-offs. This Staff Discussion Note focuses on emerging market and developing economies and proposes a framework for prioritization, packaging, and sequencing of macrostructural reforms to accelerate growth, alleviate policy trade-offs, and support the green transition. The note shows that prioritizing the removal of the most binding constraints on economic activity, bundling reforms (governance, business deregulation, and external sector reforms), and appropriate sequencing of other reforms (such as labor market and credit sector reforms) can help front-load reform gains. In emerging market and developing economies with large initial structural gaps, the estimated output effects of such a major reform package are sizable—about 4 percent in two years and 8 percent in four years. Achieving higher growth and lower absolute carbon emissions over time requires a well-designed strategy that includes both macrostructural and green reforms.
abstract_zh: 在新冠疫情大流行之后，新兴市场和发展中经济体正努力应对经济创伤、社会紧张以及政策空间减少的问题。当前迫切需要采取政策行动，以在近期促进增长并支持正在进行的绿色转型。与此同时，高企的公共债务和持续高通胀限制了政策空间，带来了艰难的政策权衡。本份工作人员讨论文件聚焦于新兴市场和发展中经济体，提出了一个框架，用于排定宏观结构性改革的优先次序、组合搭配与先后顺序，以加速增长、缓解政策权衡并支持绿色转型。文件表明，优先消除对经济活动最具约束力的障碍，将改革打包推进（治理、商业去监管以及对外部门改革），并对其他改革（如劳动力市场和信贷部门改革）作出适当的排序，有助于提前获得改革收益。在初始结构性差距较大的新兴市场和发展中经济体中，此类重大改革方案估计的产出效应相当可观：两年内约为4%，四年内约为8%。要实现更高的增长和长期更低的绝对碳排放，需要一项精心设计的战略，既包括宏观结构性改革，也包括绿色改革。

title: International knowledge spillovers
A Comprehensive Package of Macroeconomic Policy Measures for Implementing China’s Climate Mitigation Strategy
abstract: This paper presents ways for China to achieve its climate goals while also attain high-quality growth—growth that is balanced, inclusive, and green. Using a dynamic computable general equilibrium model that is calibrated to China, multiple scenarios are considered that incorporate a sequence of layered policies: (i) frontloading mitigation with an earlier emissions peak, (ii) power market reforms, and (iii) economic rebalancing. The results highlight that these policies can significantly contribute to the success of the climate strategy overall, including by lowering the shadow price of carbon as well as the associated mitigation costs. Distribution analysis offers proposals to lessen the impact on vulnerable households.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了中国在实现其气候目标的同时，实现高质量增长（即平衡、包容和绿色的增长）的路径。利用依据中国校准的动态可计算一般均衡模型，本文考察了包含一系列分层政策的多种情景：（i）提前减排，使排放提前达峰；（ii）电力市场改革；（iii）经济再平衡。结果表明，这些政策能够显著促进气候战略的整体成功，包括降低碳的影子价格以及相关的减排成本。分配分析为减轻对弱势家庭的影响提出了建议。

title: Getting on Track to Net Zero: Accelerating a Global Just Transition in This Decade
The Effect of Tariffs in Global Value Chains
Mitigating Climate Change: Growth-Friendly Policies to Achieve Net Zero Emissions by 2050
abstract: The paper examines climate mitigation strategies to reach net-zero emissions by mid-century, focusing on smoothing macroeconomic costs in the short- to medium-term - the horizon relevant for policymakers. It explores a comprehensive policy package, which complements carbon pricing with an initial green fiscal stimulus, consisting of green public investment and subsidies to renewables production. Model simulations show that thanks to the green public spending, the policy package boosts global output relative to the baseline for the first 15 years of the low-carbon transition. Subsequent transitional output costs resulting from further increases in carbon prices are moderate of the order of 1 percent of baseline global GDP by 2050. The findings suggest that upfront green fiscal packages could help smooth the transition to a low-carbon economy. In the current context of the Covid-19 economic crisis, they would help support the recovery from the crisis and put the global economy on a greener, more sustainable path.
abstract_zh: 本文研究到本世纪中叶实现净零排放的气候减缓策略，重点关注在短期至中期（即政策制定者关心的时间范围内）平抑宏观经济成本。文章探讨了一套综合性政策组合，该组合将碳定价与初始绿色财政刺激相结合，后者包括绿色公共投资以及对可再生能源生产的补贴。模型模拟表明，得益于绿色公共支出，该政策组合在低碳转型的前15年使全球产出高于基准水平。随后，由于碳价格进一步上涨所产生的转型期产出成本是温和的，到2050年约为基准全球GDP的1%。研究结果表明，前期的绿色财政一揽子计划有助于平滑向低碳经济的转型。在当前新冠疫情经济危机的背景下，这些计划将有助于支持危机后的复苏，并使全球经济走上更加绿色、更可持续的道路。
